3 sets x 8 serves (alternate T and wide) · Scoring: 1 point for target, 0 for miss; after 2 consecutive misses: stop, 30s breath/reset, repeat. Targets: place cones or portable targets in corners, deep line, short crosscourt zone. Mark 3 zones per side: deep outside (A), middle baseline (B), short angle (C).

4 sets × 6 returns to two targets (deep cross, short center) · Machine placed on other side; medium speed. Goal: neutralize return; if miss, immediate reset routine. Ball machine basics: set feeds for pace, spin, direction; use consistent intervals (feed cadence ~1.5–2.5s depending on drill).
Machine feeds alternating to forehand/backhand · Play 12 × 1-point scenarios starting from -30 (you must win the point to erase deficit). Feed speed moderate, placement varied.
Practice cue word + 2 min visualization · Tracking: use phone to record 1-2 drills per week and a 1-minute post-session voice note (journal).
